content: tokio::sync::Semaphore is FIFO-fair (distributes permits in request order); it does NOT natively support priority or weighted lanes (open issue tokio-rs/tokio#3242 proposes prioritized semaphores). A four-lane scheduler therefore needs per-lane Semaphores sized by reserved share plus a weighted fair queuing dispatcher that selects which lane to grant next; L0/L1 non-preemptible priority is enforced by the dispatcher, not the semaphore.
